作者主页https://lit.link/zh-tw/mimu99，购买渠道目前有Fansaiko和Fansky。Fansky中月度合集价格63人民币，恰好≈Fansaiko内购买时加上手续费的价格，加上支付宝手续费后相比Fansaiko会贵6元左右，因此建议在Fansaiko中购买。
The author’s homepage is https://lit.link/zh-tw/mimu99, and purchasing channels currently include Fansaiko and Fansky. On Fansky, the monthly compilation costs 63 RMB, which is roughly equivalent to the price on Fansaiko + transaction fee. However, when you add the Alipay processing fee, it ends up being about 6 RMB more expensive than on Fansaiko, so I recommend purchasing it on Fansaiko.
